    • tryBigTakeWithContext

      public boolean tryBigTakeWithContext(net.minecraft.world.level.Level level, net.minecraft.world.phys.BlockHitResult hit, net.minecraft.world.item.ItemStack stack, com.github.crittscott.somebuckets.protection.ProtectionContext context)
      Attempts to transfer one bucket-volume from Fabric block storage or a world source into a finite bucket using explicit player or automation identity.

      Block storage owns dispatch when present. Protection is checked before mutation. The server commits the storage/world change and credits the bucket atomically; the client only predicts acceptance.

      Returns:
      true for an accepted prediction or completed server pickup

    • tryBigPlaceWithContext

      public boolean tryBigPlaceWithContext(net.minecraft.world.level.Level level, net.minecraft.world.phys.BlockHitResult hit, net.minecraft.world.item.ItemStack stack, com.github.crittscott.somebuckets.protection.ProtectionContext context, boolean allowFaceOffset)
      Attempts to transfer one bucket-volume from a finite bucket into Fabric block storage or the world using explicit player or automation identity.

      Block storage owns dispatch when present. Protection precedes mutation, and server success debits the finite bucket only after the destination accepts the transfer. The client only predicts acceptance.

      Parameters:
      allowFaceOffset - whether world placement may use the neighbor along the clicked face
      Returns:
      true for an accepted prediction or completed server placement

    • trySourceTake

      public boolean trySourceTake(net.minecraft.world.level.Level level, net.minecraft.world.phys.BlockHitResult hit, net.minecraft.world.item.ItemStack stack, net.minecraft.world.entity.player.Player player, net.minecraft.world.InteractionHand hand)

    • trySourceTakeWithContext

      public boolean trySourceTakeWithContext(net.minecraft.world.level.Level level, net.minecraft.world.phys.BlockHitResult hit, net.minecraft.world.item.ItemStack stack, com.github.crittscott.somebuckets.protection.ProtectionContext context)
      Attempts to assign an empty Source Bucket or sink matching fluid using explicit identity.

      Fabric block storage owns dispatch when present. Protection precedes mutation. Server success consumes one source volume. An empty bucket records its identity; an assigned bucket accepts only matching input and remains unchanged. The client only predicts acceptance.

      Returns:
      true for an accepted prediction or completed server intake
